fixes.explanation: True! The LORD says, "Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one." (Numbers 33:54). Nobody gets a share by shouting the loudest, and nobody gets one by being first in line. The size of the clan sets the size of the share. And the LORD adds that whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. I wish my cookie boxes sorted themselves that fairly.

Nice try, friend! But the LORD names someone else. He says the men to assign the land are "Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun." (Numbers 34:17). Bezalel and Eldad aren't named in this passage. Eleazar and Joshua are the two on this job.
